items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: I think Tony Hendra, who was a British actor himself, played Sir Ian or whomever

ctx.x: Did the tape, did the scene take a lot of time to film?

Oh. Well I did two days’ work on this film. Some of my — my key scene really was cut from the film and it wasn’t really my fault it was because another scene didn’t work out © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-

and this scene depended on it. Luckily on the DVD you can see it as a bonus scene. But they just sort of made an effort to leave me in as much as they could once they had cut my key scene. But between all my various scenes, one was in a record store that they did leave in, the in-store signing, and then some remnants of the one the night before where I have to talk them into going to a radio station and then we had to cut the radio station. Two days work on the film. All different — you know no written lines…
